# Interactive Documentation Application

The Awtsmoos lets canonical Markdown and generated evidence become searchable, teachable public doorways without surrendering source provenance. The application is served at **`/docs/`** from `geelooy/docs/`.

## Primary modes

### Learn — `/docs/?view=learn`

Five source-backed tracks open canonical tutorial documents. Completion state is optional browser-local storage only.

### API Explorer — `/docs/?view=api`

Consumes generated API tutorial shards and supports family/health/shape/confidence/text filters, route deep links, contract/caller/test evidence, tutorial links, copy-source, guarded examples, and route-aware Ask.

### Project Explorer — `/docs/?view=projects`

Consumes enriched project packets and supports:

- exact project-type filtering;
- public-entry/test/docs yes/no filters;
- path/title/entry/dependency text search;
- selected-project deep links;
- file-shape and source-entry evidence;
- public HTML entry evidence;
- lexical symbol summaries;
- incoming/outgoing project dependency evidence;
- external package evidence;
- human project-family and generated project-tutorial links;
- project-aware Ask and source-path copy.

### Documents

Global search supports free text and `category:`, `kind:` and `path:` filters. Markdown reading preserves provenance, favorites/recents, deep links and retrieval-first Ask.

## Publication v5

`geelooy/docs/generated/manifest.json` is the single public data entry. It declares transport-bounded search/project/API-tutorial arrays plus categories, page metadata and lossless Markdown content shards. Project packets are richer in v5 while remaining bounded and source-derived.

## Evidence safety

Raw Markdown HTML is not executed; authored modules may not assign `innerHTML`. Project imports/symbols/tests/public entries are labeled discovery evidence. Route method/status/header evidence remains conservative. Unknown methods never receive invented executable starters.

## Local browser state

Theme, favorites, recents, and learning completion are browser-local convenience state. They are not documentation authority or server/account data.

## Development gates

```sh
node scripts/docs/project-evidence-test.js
node scripts/docs/tutorial-engine-test.js
node scripts/docs/search-engine-test.mjs
node scripts/docs/validate-docs.js
```

After frontend/publication changes, sweep every manifest-declared JSON response through the real server and exercise Home/Learn/API/Projects/Documents/Search/Ask at desktop and mobile widths.
